Custom Pools and Outdoor Living, we specialize in creating custom swimming pool designs tailored to your unique preferences. Our experienced team collaborates with you to ensure your pool reflects your style and meets your needs. From modern infinity pools to classic designs, we provide a range of options to suit any landscape. Let's make your dream pool a reality! Pool Repair If your pool needs repairs, we've got you covered. From leaks repairs and cracks to equipment malfunctions, our team can quickly diagnose and fix any issue. Pool Renovation Is your pool looking outdated or in need of a refresh? Our team can help you renovate your pool with new features, finishes, and designs. More than pools. We also have a line of oil burning fire bowls that can be added to any existing backyard. These are had made fire bowls and completely custom. We also provide and install fake palm trees. These trees are 13 or 16' tall and withstand winds up to 75 mph. They are maintenance free and will last forever. These too, can be installed in any backyard. ISs golf your thing? We can add putting green to your backyard oasis. Are you tired of mowing or grass clipping being brought in the house with the dogs. Let us install pet friendly turf in your backyard and forget about the dogs. About No Problem Custom Pools About Us. No Problem Custom Pools is a family owned and operated business based out of Midlothian Texas that services all of DFW. We value the personal attention to detail that you deserve. We have been in the residential construction business as a restoration expert since 2002. In January of 2020 we started building custom swimming pools and outdoor living because we noticed that the market was missing something, and we knew that we could add what was missing, we truly feel we have achieved our goals. Since we started, we have made our mark by building swimming pools all over the Dallas Fort Worth Metroplex and have even started to expand into Waco and parts of East Texas. We hope to earn the opportunity to be trusted to build your backyard oasis and make your vision a reality. Social Dive into our stunning pool designs and completed backyards. reviews.text: Thanks to Aaron and No Problem Pools, we now have a beautiful, resort-style pool that our family will enjoy for years to come. If you’re thinking of building a pool, look no further—this is the company you want on your side!  Aaron is honest and transparent and cares deeply about the quality.  Absolutely recommend them.
reviews.author: Ben Peterson

reviews.text: Aaron with No Problem Custom Pools was a pleasure to work with. He worked with us and worked within our budget and I honestly can say he went above and beyond and made sure everything was what we wanted. When we have questions, he acts fast. Aaron was with us every step of the way and even after completion, he still follows up with us. Building a pool is a big commitment and we got numerous quotes, but No Problem Custom Pools stood out above them all. Highly recommend, you won't be disappointed!
reviews.author: Jeremy Daniels

reviews.text: Aaron has made my backyard dream come true. All the city, HOA and other hassles that we had to deal with, i can bet, noone else would be able to complete the pool for us. I would 100% recommend No Problem pools to anyone looking to build custom pools. Thank you Aaron. Absolutely love your work.
reviews.author: Saurabhi Paudyal

reviews.text: Aaron just finished our pool and we can’t say enough great things! It came out beautifully and he did such a great job managing the project and keeping it on track. He worked with us within our budget and was very flexible with changes we made along the way. 5 stars!! You can’t go wrong with No Problem Pools!!
reviews.author: Holly Peterson

reviews.text: We absolutely love our pool from No Problem Custom Pools. Aaron worked with us every step of the way. First dig to pool fill was 4 weeks! Any questions I have are answered very quickly as well! We couldn’t be happier with how it turned out!
reviews.author: Dana Thornton

reviews.text: We used No Problem for a house fire, so using them dor a pool was a no brainer for us. Aaron is trustworthy business owner who doesn’t price gouge and has a great attention to detail. From HOA approval to completion was around 6 weeks, which is CRAZY right now. We are still waiting on fire bowls due to supply chain issues, but we are so close to done, i figured it was worth a post!
reviews.author: Lisa Owen

reviews.text:
Unfortunately, I am forced to change the rating I submitted late last year. While No Problem Custom Pools did get my pool up and running after my previous builder abandoned the project - there is some warranty work (huge stains in plaster) that was initially identified in May 2021 that still needs to be addressed. Also, the plaster I chose was Aqua white pebble with a Puerto Rican blend. As it turns out, I recently discovered and confirmed that the Puerto Rican blend was not added. Instead, they added some crushed abalone shell since it also has an iridescent shimmer but is of lower quality. When I brought this to their attention I was told by No Problem Pools “we have never done that finish because 1. It’s very expensive and 2. The applicators that do shoot it charge a lot more for it and there are only a handful of guys that can shoot it. It’s just something we don’t offer”. However, this was never brought up during the selection process.

Needless to say, after being given the runaround and now lack of response - it is now February 2024 and my pool plaster is still badly stained due to poor workmanship and unfulfilled warranty obligations.

****Update as of 3/26/2024****

And finally, after almost 3 years, No Problem pools did the right thing. My pool has been re-plastered with Aqua White pebble and Puerto Rico blend.

****Update as of 4/1/2024****

You know, there’s something to be said if your response is that of a novel! My tail between my legs you say? It didn’t take much convincing you that the entire thing needed to be re-plastered to include the Puerto Rico blend that “you don’t even offer”.

How funny of you to say you’re an honest person, (you were until you weren’t) after all, you wouldn’t even stop by to see how the project was turning out - I can only assume that was due to shame.

I will end this by saying thank you for acknowledging the type of person I am - 9 out of 10 times, my kindness gets mistaken for weakness.
reviews.author: Ines Castellano

reviews.text: No Problem Pools is a great value. They built a great pool for us. Aaron was very responsive to our design ideas and we love it!
reviews.author: Doug Smithzx
